headline: Guild day 1: Lead set four priorities - compass 'holding' setups (GATE2), quiet days, the long side, short bursts - and gave each role a task.
bullets: P1 GATE2: build setups that trade with the side SPY holds after a confirmed reading (it stays on that side at the close 89-97% of the time; direction from there is a coin flip).
P2 Quiet days: 11 of 23 live sessions were quiet and they are the book's weakest (Primary -0.096R quiet vs +0.224R on down days).
P3 Long side: longs lost in all 7 accounts on 11-05; the book makes money mainly on down days.
P4 Short bursts: on 11-05, bursts that stopped out together cost -300.7R.
Nothing tested yet today; the locked holdout stays shut; no live changes.
next: Builder posts the GATE2 plan; Scout posts 3 quiet-day / long rules; Skeptic ranks the 6 open near-misses.
